records.title: United Arab Emirates
records.description: One of the world's largest remittance-sending markets, with outbound corridors to India, Pakistan, the Philippines and Egypt routed through licensed exchange houses, bank rails and the Aani instant payments platform.

records.title: Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
records.description: A top-three global remittance-sending market under SAMA oversight, where Vision 2030 fintech licensing and the sarie instant payments system are shifting flows from cash to real-time digital rails.

records.title: State of Qatar
records.description: One of the highest expatriate-workforce shares in the world, sustaining dense remittance corridors to South Asia, Egypt and the Philippines via QCB's Fawran instant payments rail.

records.title: Republic of India
records.description: The world's largest remittance-receiving market, anchored by UPI's real-time domestic rail and RBI-supervised cross-border linkages now extending UPI acceptance abroad.

records.title: Republic of Singapore
records.description: A regional treasury and fintech hub under MAS oversight, connecting the FAST/PayNow domestic rail to cross-border real-time links such as PayNow-UPI and PayNow-PromptPay.
